intro: Every part we dispatch has been measured against your drawing. Not a sample from the batch — every part. It is the single commitment that has kept eight-plus Tier-1 customers re-ordering, and it is built into an ISO 9001:2015 quality management system covering production and inspection.

headline.label: of parts inspected against customer specification before dispatch

stages.title: Incoming inspection
stages.text: Raw material — sheet, coil, tube and bar — is checked against specification and supplier documentation before it is released to the shop floor. Material that does not conform does not enter production.

stages.title: In-process inspection
stages.text: Checks are made at each transfer between operations — after blanking, forming, drawing, machining and welding — so a die drift or fixture shift is caught at the station that caused it rather than at final inspection.

stages.title: Final inspection
stages.text: Finished parts and sub-assemblies are measured against the customer drawing, then packed. Inspection records accompany the dispatch documentation your goods-inward team needs.

instruments.name: Height gauge
instruments.use: Vertical dimension and step measurement from the surface plate

instruments.name: Vernier calliper
instruments.use: General internal, external and depth dimensions

instruments.name: Surface plate
instruments.use: Reference datum for layout and height gauging

commitments.title: Inspection against your drawing
commitments.text: We measure to the specification you supply, not to a generic internal standard. Where a drawing is ambiguous, we raise it before production rather than interpret it.

commitments.title: Documentation on request
commitments.text: Inspection records, material details and dimensional reports can accompany dispatch. Tell us what your goods-inward process requires and we will format to it.

commitments.title: Open to audit
commitments.text: Customer and third-party audits of our process, tool room and inspection facilities are welcome. Several of our current Tier-1 relationships began with exactly that visit.

commitments.title: Corrective action, not excuses
commitments.text: If a non-conformance reaches you, we investigate root cause at the operation that produced it, correct the tooling or process, and report back.

note: Copies of our ISO 9001:2015 certificate, MSME/Udyam registration and GST registration are available on request — or download the company profile for a summary.
